metadata.description: Empirical comparison of baseline BM25 retrieval vs context expansion (window=1, window=2)
metadata.note_on_metrics: Context expansion increases evidence coverage (Context Recall) around retrieved chunks on the same page. Original BM25 ranking metrics (Recall@10, MRR, nDCG@10) reflect ranking quality and are not altered by expansion. Expansion chunks receive score=0.0.
metadata.timing_note: Latencies are local measurements with warm-up and repeated execution.
